summary:
Frontend-only UI testing of the new Go Perks Prospects features (suburb picker, admin prospect flow, pitch dialog, follow-up panel, map) at 1440x900 and 390x844. Everything spec'd works end-to-end with zero defects.

1) BusinessProfile /business/profile (business@tinysvouchers.com.au): typing 'yarra' into profile-suburb-input opens profile-suburb-options with 12 options including profile-suburb-option-3013-yarraville; typing '3013' then pressing Enter picks the top match and sets the input to 'Yarraville 3013'; typing 'Footscray' without picking shows profile-suburb-hint and Save shows toast 'Pick your suburb from the list so we have the postcode'; picking Yarraville then Save shows 'Profile saved' toast and navigates back to /business; reloading /business/profile shows 'Yarraville 3013' persisted.

2) Admin /admin/prospects (admin@tinysvouchers.com.au): prospect-add-btn opens prospect-dialog; prospect-suburb-input picker works (options prospect-suburb-option-3013-yarraville clickable); added TEST_UI_Prospect_1793775435 with test_pitch_ui@example.com at '12 Anderson Street, Yarraville 3013'. Row appears in the list showing 'Yarraville 3013' + address + 'Added by you'.

3) Pitch: ticked only the TEST_ row via prospects-select-<id>; prospects-bulk-pitch opens pitch-dialog with pitch-recipients 'To 1 business: TEST_UI_Prospect_1793775435...'; pitch-note-input accepts up to 300 chars (counter 35/300); pitch-preview iframe renders with subject 'Free to join: put [Business name] in front of local Go Perks members'; pitch-send-btn clicked -> immediately shows prospect-pitch-<id> 'Pitch sending' and after polling 'Pitch sent'; row status auto-changes to 'contacted'. No skipped recipients (example.com was accepted in this env).

4) Follow-up: set contacted_at='2026-10-20T00:00:00+00:00', status='contacted' directly in Mongo for the TEST_ prospect. On reload, follow-up-panel renders 'Time to chase up 1' with follow-up-<id> showing 'Yarraville · contacted 15 days ago'; prospects-filter-chase lists exactly our row; clicking follow-up-interested-<id> removes the item from the panel (panel disappears since due list = 0) and the row status becomes 'interested' (verified in table).

5) Map: prospects-view-map shows prospects-map, prospects-map-legend with all 5 statuses + 'Suburb only' legend, 66 Leaflet markers (65 seed + our TEST_). Clicking a marker opens a popup with map-open-<id> 'Open' button and a Google Maps '/maps/dir/' Directions link. prospects-view-list toggles back.

6) Mobile 390x844: profile-suburb-options render under the input and are clickable inside the prospect-dialog; prospects-view-map renders the full map + legend; pitch-dialog layout fits the viewport (note + preview stack vertically, no overflow).

Cleanup: TEST_UI_Prospect_1793775435 deleted from Mongo at the end of the run (total prospects back to 65, zero TEST_ rows).
critical_code_review_comments: SuburbPicker.jsx is cleanly implemented with a module-level promise cache for /places/vic-suburbs and keyboard support (ArrowUp/Down/Enter/Escape). Good UX: shows profile-suburb-hint when typing without picking.
BusinessProfile.save blocks submit when f.postcode is empty with a clear toast, which backs up the picker's own hint — good double safety.
PitchDialog debounces the preview fetch 400ms on note change and skips recipients without an email — matches the spec that 'anyone who unsubscribed or was already pitched is skipped'.
FollowUpPanel derives dues from prospects.filter(p => p.follow_up) and sorts by contacted_at; panel hides itself when due=0 after an Interested click (no 'Time to chase up 0' empty state) — clean.
ProspectsMap uses dashed pins when located !== 'exact' so suburb-only prospects are visually distinct — matches legend ('Suburb only, no street address yet').
ProspectDialog enforces 'pick from list' via a client-side toast when f.suburb is set but f.postcode is empty — same pattern as BusinessProfile. Consistent.
pitch-done-btn/pitch-send-btn toggle correctly after send so the operator can review the skipped list before closing.

success_rate.backend: not tested this iteration (per request — 122/1 skipped in iter8)
success_rate.frontend: 100% on suburb picker (profile + prospect dialog), prospect add, pitch send + status transition to 'contacted', follow-up panel + interested transition, chase filter, map markers + popup + open/directions, 390px picker/map/pitch dialog

test_credentials: business@tinysvouchers.com.au / Business!2026 and admin@tinysvouchers.com.au / TinyAdmin!2026 both work as documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_UI_Prospect_1793775435 via /api/admin/prospects (UI), transitioned it through contacted (via pitch) and interested (via follow-up panel), then deleted it directly from Mongo at the end. Final prospects count restored to 65. No other data touched. The business@ seed profile was saved with suburb='Yarraville', postcode='3013' — this is a harmless change to a seeded TEST partner account (the main agent's seed profile was already incomplete).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new testids verified in UI: profile-suburb-input / profile-suburb-options / profile-suburb-option-<postcode>-<name> / profile-suburb-hint on BusinessProfile; prospect-suburb-input + same option naming on ProspectDialog; prospects-select-<id>, prospects-bulk-pitch, pitch-dialog with pitch-recipients / pitch-note-input / pitch-preview / pitch-send-btn / pitch-done-btn / pitch-skipped (not triggered here); prospect-pitch-<id> on rows (shows 'Pitch sending'|'Pitch sent'|'Pitch not sent'); follow-up-panel, follow-up-<id>, follow-up-interested-<id>, follow-up-no-<id>, prospects-filter-chase; prospects-view-list / prospects-view-map toggles with prospects-map, prospects-map-legend, map-open-<id>. Note contacted_at is stored as an ISO string in Mongo (not datetime) — that's how the server writes it. To simulate stale follow-ups: db.prospects.update_one({'business_name': name}, {'$set': {'contacted_at': '2026-10-20T00:00:00+00:00', 'status': 'contacted'}}).
rca of the issue: No defects found. Feature meets the brief: (a) Victorian suburbs API feeds a reusable SuburbPicker shared by BusinessProfile and ProspectDialog with searchable list + postcode, keyboard nav, and clear hint/toast when the user types free-text without picking; (b) PitchDialog previews a ready-made partner email, sends asynchronously, auto-marks recipients 'contacted' and surfaces per-row 'Pitch sending'/'Pitch sent'/'Pitch not sent' with the polling loop in ProspectsPage.useEffect; (c) FollowUpPanel surfaces rows where follow_up=true (contacted >= 7 days ago) with quick Interested/Not interested actions that both update status and remove the item from the panel; (d) ProspectsMap places markers (dashed when address-less) with popup containing Open (opens dialog) and Directions (Google Maps). Mobile layout works at 390px for all three dialogs and the map.
